remarks: Contemporary retreat surrounded by nature in a peaceful North Stamford setting. Wall-to-wall windows fill the home with natural light, showcasing soaring ceilings and serene views. The open floor plan connects the dining area to the spacious living room, anchored by a striking stone fireplace. The kitchen presents a great opportunity for personalization, with a layout ideal for both everyday use and entertaining. Grab a book and a blanket and head to the cozy loft retreat, complete with its own fireplace-perfect for quiet moments or creative inspiration. The main-floor primary suite is a peaceful escape, featuring an ensuite bath, oversized closets, a private deck, and its own washer and dryer for ultimate convenience. All additional bedrooms are generously sized, ideal for guests, family, or home offices. A versatile lower-level den adds even more flexible space-think media room, gym, or playroom. Outside, multiple decks provide room to dine al fresco or enjoy the beauty of the surrounding landscape. There's ample space to garden, play, or simply relax in complete privacy. Located just minutes from restaurants, shops, and the Merritt Parkway, this home blends clean contemporary design with comfort and connection in one of Stamford's most desirable neighborhoods.
